title: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro is leading a tech overhaul of Disney+ to close the gap with Netflix and YouTube, including better recommendations and vertical videos (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro is leading a tech overhaul of Disney+ to close the gap with Netflix and YouTube, including better recommendations and vertical videos — Streaming has been a drag on Disney's share price as subscriber growth stalled. A tech overhaul and more foreign-language shows are in the cards.
